get.description: Report that the API is up, and whether it can reach the database.
Start signing in: send the browser to GitHub with a new `state` and PKCE challenge.
Finish signing in when GitHub sends the browser back, then go to the web app.
Who is signed in. Answers 401 when nobody is.

post.description: Sign this browser out. While the session is valid, this needs the CSRF header.

get.description: Whether the user's Telegram chat is linked, and since when.

post.description: A one-time link to the bot that links the chat it's opened in, for 15 minutes.

get.description: Every entry, oldest first, with its messages and facts (FR-JRN-5).

patch.description: Replace a message's text, keeping the text it replaces (FR-JRN-6, FR-JRN-3).

delete.description: Delete a message. An entry's only message can't be: delete the entry (409).

Delete an entry, its messages and its facts (FR-JRN-6). When the profile cites one of the
facts, it takes `confirm=true` (409 without).

put.description:
Change a fact's fields (FR-EXT-3). Its role and project must be in the profile, unless it
already links to them (422).

delete.description:
Delete a fact (FR-EXT-3). When the profile cites it, it takes `confirm=true` (409
without).

get.description: Every entry and every fact, as a JSON file (FR-JRN-7).

Every entry and every fact, as a Markdown file (FR-JRN-7), with times in the time zone
`tz`, such as `Asia/Singapore`.
The change sets waiting for review, oldest first (FR-REV-1).

post.description: Accept or reject one change, or undo the decision (FR-REV-2).

put.description:
Edit the text of a new or reworded bullet. The verifier checks it again, and it waits for
a decision once more (FR-REV-2, FR-FID-7). Claude unavailable: 502, or 503 when it isn't
set up.

post.description:
Accept every change still waiting whose text passed the verifier (bulk accept). Flagged
ones keep waiting for a decision of their own.

Apply the accepted changes as one new profile version (FR-REV-3), once every change is
decided (409 before). Reasons given for rejections become style notes (FR-REV-4).

get.description:
The latest version of the profile, with its resume-rule findings. Everything is null
before a profile is loaded.

put.description:
Change the basics. The fields that changed are saved as a change set by you and a new
version (FR-PRF-11); nothing changed saves nothing. 409 when the profile is no longer at
`baseVersion`.
Change a role, as `PUT /api/profile/basics` does the basics.
Change an education entry, as `PUT /api/profile/basics` does the basics.
Change a project, as `PUT /api/profile/basics` does the basics.

Change a bullet: its text, status (benching needs a reason, FR-PRF-4), strength,
verification and tags, as `PUT /api/profile/basics` does the basics. Your own words aren't
checked by the verifier, but the resume rules' findings show on the page.

get.description: Every version, newest first, with what each one's change set did.
A version, with what it changed against its parent.

post.description:
Save a copy of version `number` as the newest version (FR-PRF-3); the versions in between
stay. 409 when the profile is no longer at `baseVersion`, or already matches that version.

Bullet.title: Bullet
Bullet.description: One highlight line under a role, education entry or project.

ChangeValue.title: ChangeValue
ChangeValue.description: A change from one number to another, e.g. `50 → 12` (minutes).

Citation.title: Citation
Citation.description: A bullet in the latest profile version that cites a fact.

ClaimJudgement.title: ClaimJudgement
ClaimJudgement.description: The claim check's verdict on one claim in the text.

CourseworkSubset.title: CourseworkSubset
CourseworkSubset.description: The courses to list for one role type.

Derivation.title: Derivation
Derivation.description: A figure in the text that code computed from a fact metric, and how (FR-FID-2).

DiffPart.title: DiffPart
DiffPart.description:
Words the texts share, or that one of them has. Its spaces count, so the parts rebuild
each text exactly.

Education.title: Education
Education.description: A degree or qualification (JSON Resume `education` entry).

Fact.title: Fact
Fact.description:
Something that happened, extracted from a journal entry, an imported bullet or a
repository's history.

FactEdit.title: FactEdit
FactEdit.description: A fact's fields that the owner can change, all of them at once.

MessageEdit.title: MessageEdit
MessageEdit.description: A message's text before an edit.

Note.title: Note
Note.description: A remark attached to an item, e.g. a warning about what must not be claimed.

OpenQuestion.title: OpenQuestion
OpenQuestion.description: A missing detail that blocks a stronger bullet.

Profile.title: Profile
Profile.description: The master profile: the superset every resume, page and LinkedIn text is drawn from.

ProfilePage.title: ProfilePage
ProfilePage.description: The latest version, or nulls before a profile is loaded.

Project.title: Project
Project.description: A personal or academic project (JSON Resume `projects` entry).

RepoItem.title: RepoItem
RepoItem.description: A pull request, a commit or a repository's description that a GitHub fact rests on.

RepoSource.title: RepoSource
RepoSource.description: Where a fact from GitHub comes from (FR-GH-6): its repository and the items it cites.

RoleType.title: RoleType
RoleType.description: A kind of job the owner applies for, e.g. backend or ML.

SkillLine.title: SkillLine
SkillLine.description: One line of a skills section, e.g. `Languages: Python, SQL`.

SkillPreset.title: SkillPreset
SkillPreset.description: The skills section to use for one role type.

SocialProfile.title: SocialProfile
SocialProfile.description: An online profile, e.g. GitHub or LinkedIn (JSON Resume `basics.profiles`).

StrengthOverride.title: StrengthOverride
StrengthOverride.description: A bullet's strength for one role type, when it differs from the default.

Summary.title: Summary
Summary.description: A summary paragraph for one role type. Off by default.

Swap.title: Swap
Swap.description: An approved alternative phrasing: the same fact in another audience's words.

VerifierReport.title: VerifierReport
VerifierReport.description:
What the verifier found in one text. Text that doesn't pass is flagged: it's shown to the
owner, who must accept it by hand (FR-FID-7).

VersionChange.title: VersionChange
VersionChange.description: One difference between a version and its parent.
